notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch, Playwright/CDP, and Claude-in-Chrome (real browser) all failed to connect to www.dille-kamille.com (83.143.184.156) - confirmed genuine network-egress-level unreachability from this workstation, not a site WAF block (general IPv4 egress to other hosts worked fine; even a real logged-in Chrome browser via CDP could not load the site). This matches a prior documented fix for this exact host (memory note: r.jina.ai fixed a plain ECONNREFUSED egress issue on Dille & Kamille before). Used r.jina.ai reader proxy as the network route after exhausting all 3 tiers; canonical dille-kamille.com URLs kept in `link`. Checked main nav mega-menu (Kitchen/Home/Garden/Bath & shower/Food & Drink/Gifts/Autumn/New/Stores) - no Clearance/Outlet/Sale item in nav or footer. Site search: 'sale' (38 results) and 'korting'/Dutch-discount (1 result) were false-positive fuzzy matches (mostly bath/cooking SALT products, one random toy) - not a real category. 'outlet', 'aanbieding' (Dutch: deal/offer) both returned 'no results'. Site search for 'discount' (93 results, all with a '%' discounted-price badge) led me to probe /discounts/ directly, which resolved to a genuine Magento category PLP (not a search results page): title 'Discounts!', on-page copy 'We're cleaning up! That is why you now get a discount on many different items in our store.' - this is a clear permanence/end-of-line-clearance signal (explicitly framed as clearing out stock, not a dated seasonal campaign), reinforced by 44 of 93 items being out-of-stock (typical of a discontinued-stock clearance shelf rather than an active promotional sale). Toolbar shows '93 articles found', matching the in-stock(49)+not-in-stock(44) facet sum. Classified as Clearance per the site's own taxonomy/copy, not a generic temporary Sale, so no ambiguity flag was set - though the merge step's name-pattern net may still flag it since the page is titled 'Discounts' rather than literally 'Clearance/Outlet'; this note documents the real page evidence behind the classification. Also probed /sale/, /outlet/, /clearance/, /last-chance/, /korting/, /opruiming/ directly - all 404.
